notes: Firmware Hub self-update for Master AND Slave from the web admin: check button, "Оновити зараз" only when a newer version exists, daily background check with a one-time Telegram notification per version, hard lock-out while a generator/charge run is active.
Redesigned on-device LVGL interface (ui_theme design system) and themed web UI; LVGL heap, mbedtls and background task stacks moved to PSRAM — web server and Telegram now survive together.
Grid presence is resolved ONLY from the external Slave sensor when its rule is enabled (the inverter API lies while the generator runs); per-field persistence of every automation setting.

OTA safety: accidental-downgrade guard with explicit rollback checkbox, wrong-device and non-app image rejection, real version embedded in the app descriptor; board-aware Slave updates (boards{} manifest, no cross-board offers).

Reliability: SSR auto-restore after Slave reboot, RF command repeats with honest Slave-side status, Telegram anomaly-alert debounce, Slave crash surfacing (reset_reason + panic_info with backtrace) in the event log.
Optional SD-card logging (event log + metrics CSV); device works fully without a card.
